subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should #92201 remain the broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay umbrella until the chosen prevention PR lands, or should maintainers make #94228/#99382 the canonical remaining work now that #92916 and #95430 landed?
rationale: The recovery slices are implemented, but current main still preserves newer Claude completed thinking on replay and changing that policy is compatibility-sensitive provider behavior.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave #92201 open until #99383 or an equivalent prevention fix lands, then close it with the merged commit and release proof.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close #92201 as superseded by #94228/#99382 after posting a clear handoff that the recovery half is complete and prevention remains there.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the recovery fixes as enough for now and leave prevention to a later provider replay review, accepting continued first-request replay failures.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave #92201 open until #99383 or an equivalent prevention fix lands, then close it with the merged commit and release proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available decision owner from the issue discussion and prior review routing for this provider/session replay policy choice.
